checks.legal: CourtListener and Justia could not be searched directly: the network proxy refuses both hosts and the fetch tool refuses unsearched URLs (Oct. 14, 2026). A site-restricted web search of courtlistener.com/justia.com was run instead, plus news searches. News search for his name with lawsuit/court terms returned only commentary on his advocacy; no case naming him as a party found.
checks.foreign: 2026 and 2025 House candidate reports read directly: no foreign-located assets or foreign income (international index/bond funds only). FARA: exact-name search of the FARA bulk files (registrants, short forms, foreign principals), Oct. 13, 2026: no match.
checks.claims: Campaign site unreachable. Mechanical sample = every checkable bio claim in his own Ballotpedia survey answers (5), the Arizona Medical Association's announcement of his run (3), and the campaign-biography claim quoted by FOX 10 (1). 9 rated: 6 true, 1 partly, 2 unverifiable. Ads not identified.

networth.note: Sum of all 91 Schedule A value ranges minus the two Schedule D liabilities, from the 2026 candidate report (period Jan. 1, 2025–May 22, 2026). Includes spouse and dependent-child assets.

note.t: Largest holdings: his medical practice M. Zuhdi Jasser, MD PC (100%, $500K–$1M, S-corp income $50K–$100K), held through the Jasser Revocable Trust with a BMO account ($100K–$250K); a Peoria, AZ rental property ($100K–$250K, rent $2.5K–$5K); Z Liberty LLC consulting (100%, $50K–$100K); Schwab 401(k)/profit-sharing index funds; Interpretive Translation of the Koran, LLC (100%, $15K–$50K, owns book rights); Z Leasing LLC (inactive). Spouse holds retirement accounts (Mayo 403(b), Merrill Lynch IRA, AZ Center for Hematology plan) and small individual stocks (Tesla, NVIDIA, Apple, Amazon, Merck, GE, Newmont) each under $15K. Earned income 2025: $58,876 from his practice, $79,204 from Advanced Nuclear Cardiology PLLC, $75,000 from Z Liberty LLC; spouse salaries from Banner Health Network and Mayo Clinic Arizona. Liabilities: office lease with CHP 1010 McDowell LLC through Feb. 2030 ($250K–$500K) and an American Express balance ($10K–$15K). Positions: president of the American Islamic Forum for Democracy; senior fellow, Center for Security Policy; medical director for bioethics, Banner Health Network; boards of the Arizona Medical Association, NotMyKid and the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office advisory board. No foreign assets or income.
